title: Leibniz's monadology of observing entities

tellings.quote: Now this is something that Livinets suggested back in 1700. He had this monodology

plain: A researcher, Don Hoffman, says on a podcast that the philosopher Leibniz already suggested his idea back in 1700, in a work called the Monadology, which pictures the world as made up of observing entities. Hoffman brings it up to show that his own view of reality has a very old ancestor.
